inputs.value: Instrumental industrial arcade rock at 144 BPM in E minor. A clipped baritone electric guitar plays a heavy syncopated riff answered by a staccato brass synthesizer. Thick picked bass, acoustic kick and toms, metallic foundry percussion in a precise backbeat, small gaps between phrases. Strutting mechanical groove, fierce tuneful hook then a half-time bridge and rising return. Clear instrumental mix, no singing, no spoken voice.
